Container.Name: awtrix-flights
Container.Overview: Displays live aircraft overflying your home on an AWTRIX 3 LED display (OpenSky Network / ADS-B). Each detected aircraft is shown with callsign, airline, country, altitude, speed and a heading-oriented icon. Zero pip dependencies, MQTT publishing, anti-spam, multi-display support.

Config.Name: HOME_LAT
Config.Description: Latitude of your home in decimal degrees (required). Google Maps -> right-click your home -> What's here?

Config.Name: HOME_LON
Config.Description: Longitude of your home in decimal degrees (required).

Config.Name: RADIUS_KM
Config.Description: Detection radius around home in km. An aircraft is shown only when it comes within this distance of your coordinates (e.g. 10 = show aircraft within 10 km).

Config.Name: MIN_ALT_M
Config.Description: Minimum aircraft altitude in meters (aircraft below this are ignored).

Config.Name: AWTRIX_HOST
Config.Description: AWTRIX unit(s), comma-separated for multiple displays (e.g. 192.168.1.27,192.168.1.123).

Config.Name: AWTRIX_PORT
Config.Description: AWTRIX API HTTP port (80 on firmware 0.98; 7001 is silent).

Config.Name: MESSAGE_TEMPLATE
Config.Description: Display template. Placeholders: {callsign} {country} {airline} {category} {altitude_m} {altitude_ft} {speed_ms} {speed_kmh} {distance_km} {track} {direction}. Example: {callsign} {airline} {direction} {altitude_ft}ft

Config.Name: ICON_ENABLED
Config.Description: Heading-oriented plane icon (true/false).

Config.Name: ICON_COLOR
Config.Description: Icon RGB color (R,G,B).

Config.Name: AWTRIX_BEARING
Config.Description: Screen orientation in degrees: angle between the top of the display and geographic north, clockwise (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W).

Config.Name: POLL_INTERVAL_SEC
Config.Description: OpenSky polling interval in seconds.

Config.Name: NOTIFY_COOLDOWN_SEC
Config.Description: Anti-spam: minimum delay between displays of the same aircraft (seconds).

Config.Name: MQTT_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable MQTT publishing of detections (true/false).

Config.Name: MQTT_HOST
Config.Description: MQTT broker address (e.g. Home Assistant IP).

Config.Name: MQTT_PORT
Config.Description: MQTT broker port.

Config.Name: MQTT_USER
Config.Description: MQTT username (optional).

Config.Name: MQTT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: MQTT password (optional).

Config.Name: MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX
Config.Description: MQTT topic prefix (topics: <prefix>/detection, <prefix>/status).

Config.Name: AWTRIX_MQTT_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable AWTRIX NG MQTT publishing (true/false) — publishes flight display directly to AWTRIX via MQTT on topics <prefix>/cmd/apps/pushed/avion.

Config.Name: AWTRIX_MQTT_PREFIXES
Config.Description: AWTRIX NG MQTT prefixes, comma-separated (e.g. awtrix1,awtrix2) — each maps to <prefix>/cmd/apps/pushed/avion.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs.
